learn.title: Azure Advisor, Service Health, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, Application Insights
objectives: Describe what Azure Advisor recommends and how to act on its recommendations.
Explain the three parts of Azure Service Health: Azure status, Service Health and Resource Health.
Describe how Azure Monitor collects, analyses and responds to metrics and logs.
Explain Log Analytics, alerts and action groups, and Application Insights.
Choose the right monitoring tool for a scenario.
concepts: Azure Advisor

A free service that analyses your resource configuration and usage, then gives personalised best-practice recommendations in five categories: Reliability, Security, Performance, Operational Excellence and Cost. You decide whether to act on them.
Advisor score
A percentage that shows how closely your resources follow Advisor's best practices, overall and per category.
Azure status
A public, global page showing Azure service health across all regions. It's for broad incidents and doesn't need sign-in.
Service Health
A personalised view of the Azure services and regions you use: service issues, planned maintenance, health advisories and security advisories, with alerts and incident history.
Resource Health
The health of your individual resources, such as one VM: Available, Degraded, Unavailable or Unknown, including whether a platform event caused a problem.
Azure Monitor
The platform that collects metrics and logs from Azure, on-premises and other clouds, then lets you analyse, visualise and respond to them (alerts, autoscale).
Metrics vs logs
Metrics are numeric values over time, good for near real-time charts and alerts. Logs are detailed records of events and data that you query.
Log Analytics
The Azure portal tool for writing Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries against log data stored in a Log Analytics workspace.
Alerts and action groups
Alert rules (metric, log search, activity log) fire when conditions are met. Action groups say who is notified (email, SMS, push, voice) and what runs (Function, Logic App, runbook, webhook).
Application Insights
The application performance monitoring feature of Azure Monitor: request rates, response times, failures, dependencies, users and availability tests, for apps on Azure, on-premises or other clouds.
comparisons: Monitor tells you what is happening (telemetry, alerts). Advisor tells you what you should change (recommendations).
Service Health reports problems with the Azure platform itself. Monitor reports how your own resources and apps are behaving.
Azure status vs Service Health vs Resource Health
Global and public, then your services and regions, then one specific resource.
Application Insights instruments and monitors applications. Log Analytics is where you query log data, including Application Insights data.
Metric alert vs activity log alert
Metric alerts watch numeric values such as CPU. Activity log alerts fire on events such as a resource being deleted or a Service Health notice.
traps: Advisor doesn't apply its recommendations automatically. You choose to act, postpone or dismiss.
Azure status shows only broad incidents. For issues that affect your own services and regions, use Service Health.
Service Health is about Azure's platform. A bug in your own app shows up in Monitor or Application Insights, not Service Health.
Application Insights isn't limited to apps hosted in Azure.
Log Analytics queries use KQL, not T-SQL.
An alert rule on its own doesn't notify anyone; an action group does the notifying or the automation.
revision: Advisor = recommendations: Reliability, Security, Performance, Operational Excellence, Cost.
Service Health = Azure status (global) + Service Health (yours) + Resource Health (one resource).
Azure Monitor = collect metrics and logs, then analyse, visualise and respond.
Log Analytics = KQL queries over a Log Analytics workspace.
Alerts = metric, log search and activity log; action groups = notifications and automation.
Application Insights = APM for any app, anywhere.
'What's wrong with Azure?' Service Health. 'What's wrong with my app?' Monitor. 'What should I improve?' Advisor.
